title: ManifestationRevision — attached_harness profile (DESIGN.md §7.2; C3a)
description: The C3a attached_harness ManifestationRevision profile: the §7.2 record shape verbatim, constrained to host_kind attached_harness — the developer-attached agent harness (Claude Code, Codex, ...) speaking BPP through byom-mcp. Carries the package/adapter digest, protocol feature set, requested security profiles, and controller domain the C3a sheet names. Assurance honesty (sheet): the attached harness holds ambient authority — requested_security_profiles are requests and observed_assurance_refs record what was actually observed; guardrails are cooperative + audit. A package, model, adapter, controller, or material security-profile change creates a new revision; no update silently inherits authority (§7.2).

previous_digest.description: Prior revision digest when superseding (§7.2 revision chain); absent exactly on the first revision.

host_binding_ref.description: The attached-harness endpoint binding (which harness install/registration this revision names).

package_or_adapter_digest.description: Digest of the pinned harness package/adapter (the lock-manifest pins the harness versions per the C3a sheet).

feature_set.description: Protocol feature set the adapter implements (advertised via feature_info, §14.1).

requested_security_profiles.description: Security profiles the controller requests for this manifestation (e.g. developer); requests, not observations.

observed_assurance_refs.description: Assurance observations actually recorded; empty unless genuinely supplied (developer-profile honesty).

controller_domain_ref.description: The controller domain this agent manifestation binds to (§7.1; protected governance metadata).

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

digestRef.$comment: The closed family DigestRef wire (family-vectors/PROFILE.md §6.1, normative; D-R0-1): exactly the members {class, algorithm, key_ref?, value_hex}. The oneOf pins the closed class/algorithm pairing and requires key_ref exactly for the keyed erasure classes; each arm refines members of this already-closed object.

class.description: Digest class (PROFILE.md §6, D-R0-1); substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef: every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash. Wire shape, class/algorithm pairing, and key_ref presence per the ratified family profile.
